verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an in-product AI feature that analyses the user's own uploaded evidence and flags gaps such as outdated timestamps or irrelevant screenshots, so users can correct them before the audit. It also documents AI-assisted due diligence reviews. Together these deliver AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's data inside the product. missing for 10: broader AI insights beyond evidence validation and due diligence (e.g. posture-wide summaries or recommendations), detail on what AI-assisted due diligence actually outputs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Sprinto AI analyses your submission and flags gaps such as outdated timestamps or irrelevant screenshots — allowing you to correct them before audit time.
Use Sprinto AI to automatically validate your uploaded evidence for relevance, scope, and timeliness before audit submission.
Sprinto supports both manual and AI-assisted due diligence reviews.
